tweet_summary: Polymarket's own account says Mamdani's NYC mayoral odds 'collapse' and that 'if he continues falling at this rate, Cuomo would be the projected winner' — over a screenshot showing Mamdani at 90%/87% to Cuomo's 9-14%.
why_note_decision: The 'BREAKING / collapse' framing is hyperbolic clickbait — Polymarket's own screenshot shows Mamdani still at ~87-90% and Cuomo at ~9-14%. The conditional 'IF he continues falling at this rate' is technically true (any monotonic decline eventually crosses), but it's reductio-ad-absurdum trivially true. Replies overwhelmingly mock the framing. Mamdani did go on to win the November 4 2025 election with 50.78% defeating Cuomo, confirming the 'collapse' framing was wrong. But the tweet does not state a checkable false claim — it states the current odds (correctly per its own screenshot) and offers a conditional projection. This is opinion/framing, not fact-misinformation. The original note literally just restates the screenshot's numbers — that's why 104 raters said 'note not needed'.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The tweet contains no false factual claim — the screenshot is accurate and the projection is a hypothetical. The hyperbolic 'collapse' framing is opinion, not misinfo. FAIL if the bot writes a note that just restates Mamdani's current lead (that's the original note's failure — it adds no info beyond what the screenshot already shows). FAIL also if the bot uses post-hoc knowledge of the November 4 2025 result to claim the tweet was 'wrong' — at the time of writing (Oct 28 2025), the projection was speculative but not refutable.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Polymarket odds dipped in the past day, but Mamdani remains a heavy favorite (~89%) vs. Cuomo (~10%). The latest Suffolk Univ. poll reported by CBS shows Mamdani leading 44%-34%. original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Restates numbers already visible in the tweet's screenshot; argues against a hyperbolic framing rather than a checkable false claim. 104 raters tagged notHelpfulNoteNotNeeded.

fact_check.claim_verdict: framing hyperbole, no factual misinfo at time of posting
fact_check.notes: Mamdani won 50.78% on Nov 4 2025 — confirming the 'collapse' framing was off, but the tweet itself doesn't state a falsifiable claim. Speculation, not misinfo.

importance.lens_rationale: 31M impressions on a politically charged race; framing-hype is noisy but not the kind of thing notes should target.
